evidence.quote: The Digital Management programme is entirely taught in English
**Exceptions are the programmes in Digital Management (8,934 euro), Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism (7,123 euro) and Ancient Civilizations for the Contemporary World (4,350 euro).

Non-EU candidates who receive the letter of eligibility for enrolment in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program must complete the pre-enrolment procedure by logging in to the Universitaly portal and filling in the application online.
Higher Secondary School final Diploma and transcript of records (both in the original language and officially translated into Italian or English language if needed)
English language certificate AND/OR Italian language certificate: level and requirements are specified on the specific course’s web page on unive.it

notes: Tuition: the programme page states the fee for this specific programme (€8,934 per year), which the university-wide English-programmes PDF confirms as an exception to the standard fees; this is the figure used, since the standard non-EU flat taxes (€1,300 for other countries) do not apply to Digital Management. Intakes: the 30 September 2026 deadline is the Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline for non-EU applicants requiring a visa; several admission rounds exist for 2026/27 and are published on apply.unive.it, where the deadline for non-EU/visa applicants appears in the relevant admission round call. Documents: the list is from the university's non-EU enrolment page for bachelor's degrees; further programme-specific tasks may apply on apply.unive.it.

evidence.quote: A minimum B2-level knowledge of English is required.
Students must have attended school for at least 12 years in order to be eligible to enrol in a bachelor’s degree offered by an Italian university.

note.fr: Ce programme à accès limité exige un test d'entrée écrit en ligne (mathématiques et raisonnement) : SAT, CEnT-S ou TOLC-E. Les candidats non-UE ayant besoin d'un visa doivent avoir les résultats au moment de la soumission.
note.en: This limited-admission programme requires an online written entry test (mathematics and reasoning): SAT, CEnT-S or TOLC-E. Non-EU visa-requiring applicants must have results at submission.

evidence.quote: This is a limited-admission programme that requires you to take an online written entry test that evaluates your knowledge of mathematics and reasoning.
